summary: The 2026 LLM landscape is dominated by a handful of frontier families — OpenAI's GPT-5 series, Anthropic's Claude, Google's Gemini 3, and Meta's open-weight Llama — with cost-efficient challengers like DeepSeek rapidly gaining developer share. Enterprise adoption increasingly flows through cloud aggregators (AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI, Snowflake Cortex, IBM watsonx), which significantly amplifies real-world usage beyond direct-API numbers. Open-weight models now deliver close to frontier performance at a fraction of the cost, intensifying competition across the board.

models.name: GPT-5
models.popularity_notes: The default OpenAI flagship with the largest developer mindshare, available directly and through Azure OpenAI, giving it unmatched enterprise aggregator reach.
models.best_for: General-purpose production applications and agentic workflows

models.name: Gemini 3 Pro
models.popularity_notes: Released November 2025, its top Pro tier with Deep Think reasoning is natively available on Google Vertex AI, driving heavy enterprise adoption.
models.best_for: Long-context document analysis and multimodal reasoning

models.name: Claude Sonnet 4.5
models.popularity_notes: The leading model for coding tasks among developers, available via AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, and direct API for broad enterprise reach.
models.best_for: Software development and agentic coding assistants

models.name: GPT-5 mini
models.popularity_notes: The cost-efficient GPT-5 variant widely adopted for high-volume production traffic, also distributed via Azure OpenAI.

models.name: Llama 4
models.popularity_notes: The most downloaded open-weight family on HuggingFace, available through AWS Bedrock, Vertex AI, and watsonx, maximizing enterprise self-hosted and aggregator adoption.

models.name: Claude Haiku 4.5
models.popularity_notes: The fast, inexpensive Claude tier popular for scaled agentic and chat workloads, available via Bedrock and Vertex AI.
models.best_for: High-throughput chat and lightweight agentic tasks

models.name: DeepSeek V3.2
models.popularity_notes: Delivers roughly 90% of GPT-5.4's performance at about 1/50th the cost, driving rapid developer adoption for cost-sensitive use cases.
models.best_for: Budget-conscious reasoning and coding at scale

models.name: Gemini 3 Flash
models.popularity_notes: The low-cost, high-speed Gemini tier with a 1M token context at very low pricing, natively available on Vertex AI for enterprise scale.
models.best_for: High-volume long-context tasks on a budget

models.name: DeepSeek R1
models.popularity_notes: A 671B MoE (37B active) reasoning specialist with strong open-weight HuggingFace adoption and very low API pricing.

models.name: Mistral Large
models.popularity_notes: A popular European frontier model available through AWS Bedrock, Azure, and Vertex AI, giving it strong aggregator-driven enterprise adoption.
models.best_for: Multilingual enterprise applications in regulated markets
